name: modern20
description: Tooling for the Modern20 Foundry system. The system itself ships as plain ES modules and needs no build step; this manifest exists so the checks, the linters and the type checker are one command rather than nine.

scripts.lint: npm run lint:js && npm run lint:py
scripts.check: npm run check:python && npm run check:node
scripts.check:python: python3 tools/check_private.py && python3 tools/check_globals.py && python3 tools/check_app_props.py && python3 tools/check_lang.py && python3 tools/check_config.py && python3 tools/check_shadowing.py && python3 tools/check_packs.py && python3 tools/check_coverage.py && python3 tools/check_rules_links.py && python3 tools/check_capture.py && python3 tools/check_art.py && python3 tools/check_deploy.py && python3 tools/check_selftest.py && python3 tools/gen_pregens.py --check && python3 tools/gen_guide.py --check && python3 tools/gen_cover.py --check && python3 tools/gen_scene.py --check
scripts.check:node: node tools/check_models.mjs && node tools/check_templates.mjs && node tools/check_casting.mjs && node tools/check_combat.mjs && node tools/check_creatures.mjs && node tools/check_objects.mjs && node tools/check_rules.mjs
scripts.test: npm run lint && npm run check
